title: Accumulating a factorial
description: You can follow a running product through the supplied loop.

steps.description: factorial starts result and i at one. You use result for the running product and i for the next factor.
Each loop pass multiplies result by i and then increments i. The condition allows factors through n.

steps.question: For factorial(6), which i value makes the loop stop?
steps.answer: The loop stops when i reaches 7. It has already multiplied the factors 1 through 6.

steps.description: You return the accumulated product and print it. The supplied output is 720.
